snippet.title: Pionero Capital — Reveal Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
You are an immigrant coming to a new city. No money, no contacts, but ambition. Can you get to the top? Work jobs, build your company, and reach to the top of the system. Hire employees, buy expensive cars, furnish you apartments and mansions.

Wishlist on Steam: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3275210/Pionero_Capital/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=launch_ad
